step.cmd: Determine if IPOC created a Reminder (REM) WI indicating a new BP can now be established:

ul.li: If no, go to step 2.
If yes, go to step 11.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the File Control Data (M101) - Claim Action transaction and do the following:

ul.li: Select Cancel benefit period (M101-7) .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if weeks of benefits have been paid after the renewal week or after the disentitlement was terminated:

ul.li: If no, go to step 4.
If yes, go to step 5.

step.cmd: In NWS, create an IPOC REV WI as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate language.

Destination — SCC: Select the IPOC based on the region in which the claim is located in FTS:
Atlantic: 1826
Quebec: 2642
Ontario: 3056
Western Canada and Territories: 5903
End User: Select Next available user .
Issue: Select Pay history summary adjustment .
BPC: Enter the BPC of claim to be cancelled.
Comments: Type “Retroactive termination of a BP.”

Details: Type “Weeks processed on BPC [BPC of the BP to terminate] to be processed on a new BP. Remove from the PHS w/c [w/c the BP was renewed or payable due to the termination of a disentitlement] to w/c [w/c of last week processed]. Advise the Level 1 officer with REM WI when complete.”
Obtained by: Select the appropriate method.
Obtained from: Select the appropriate source.
Source details: Enter the source details.
Select Save .
Go to step 9.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if a revised registration number exists:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 6.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the BP to be terminated.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 35 - Claim Cancellation .

Remarks line 1 to 4: Type “Benefits paid on BPC [BPC of the BP to terminate] to be paid on a new BP. Remove from the PHS w/c [w/c the BP was renewed or payable due to the termination of a disentitlement] to w/c [w/c of last week processed] and establish an OP for those weeks. Advise adjudicator with REM WI when complete.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts- entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Other .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and change the registration flag as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for BP termination by IPOC.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI related to the retroactive request moves to the current workload, determine if IPOC created a REM WI:

ul.li: If no, return to step 9.
If yes, go to step 11.

step.cmd: Determine if IPOC established an OP for the weeks removed:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 12.
If no, go to step 13.

step.cmd: Input an agreed deduction equal to the benefit rate amount. For more information, refer to Applying an agreed deduction in PSCD .
In SSO, verify if the correct mainframe is selected and register a new initial claim as follows:

ul.li:
On the Claim Selection screen, do the following:
Social Insurance Number: Enter the client’s SIN.
Registration type: Select Initial .
Select Search .

Review the Name and Address screen: Note Note
For a commuter claim, complete the following fields as follows:
Ordinary place of residence different: Select Yes .
Residence postal code: Enter the workplace postal code.
Mailing address: Do the following:
First line of address: Enter the delivery address. If necessary, enter the apartment number on the first line after the delivery address.
Second line of address: Enter the city name, 2-letter state abbreviation and ZIP code. Separate the state abbreviation from the ZIP code with 2 spaces. The ZIP code may be either 5 or 9 digits. If the 9-digit format is used, use a hyphen to separate the fifth and sixth digits.
Last line of address: Type “United States.”
Postal code: Type “XXXXXX.”
Economic region-new and Economic region-old : The information is prefilled based on the client’s mailing address information. For a commuter claim, enter the economic region associated with the workplace postal code (if not prefilled when the residence postal code was entered).
Tax province: This field is prefilled based on the client’s mailing address information. For a commuter claim, select Commuters .
Responsible SCC: Select the appropriate option:
If the field is blank, enter the SCC based on the client’s address on the application.
For a commuter claim, enter the SCC associated with the workplace postal code.
Tax credit: This field is prefilled based on the client’s information.
Select Next .
On the Application Form screen, select Next .

On the Registration screen, do the following:
Pay SCC: Ensure that the SCC number is the same as shown in FTS. If the field is blank, enter the appropriate SCC:
Atlantic: Type “1121.”
Quebec: Type “2371.”
Ontario: Type “3515.”
Western Canada and Territories: Type “4812.”
Service unit: Type “01.”
Tentative BPC: If not prefilled, determine the BPC based on the client’s last day worked (LDW) and application date.
Claim source: Select Appli-web (virtual) .
Initial intake transaction (M149) required: Select No . Note

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-06-00-00 letter, completing the appropriate fields.
In NWS, determine if there is an AI WI or a CB WI:

ul.li: If yes, complete the WI and go to step 16.
If no, go to step 16.

step.cmd: When the REM WI is received, determine the BT requested for the calculation:

ul.li: If the BT is regular, refer to Calculating or recalculating a claim for regular benefits . Calculating or recalculating a claim for regular benefits
If the BT is sickness, refer to Calculating or recalculating a claim for sickness benefits . Calculating or recalculating a claim for sickness benefits

If the BT is sickness, maternity and parental, refer to Calculating or recalculating a claim for sickness, maternity and parental benefits. Calculating or recalculating a claim for sickness, maternity and parental benefits.
If the BT is maternity and parental, refer to Calculating or recalculating a claim for maternity and parental benefits . Calculating or recalculating a claim for maternity and parental benefits
If the BT is parental, refer to Calculating or recalculating a claim for parental benefits . Calculating or recalculating a claim for parental benefits
If the BT is compassionate care, refer to Calculating or recalculating a claim for CCB . Calculating or recalculating a claim for CCB
If the BT is family caregiver benefits, refer to Calculating or recalculating a claim for family caregiver benefits . Calculating or recalculating a claim for family caregiver benefits
